definition: A person who is studying at a school or university.
exampleSentence: Every student must bring an ID card to the final exam.

definition: A single unit of language that has a meaning.
exampleSentence: Look up any new word in the dictionary while you read.

definition: A description of events, real or imagined.
exampleSentence: Before sleeping, the children asked their father for a funny story.

definition: The work a person does regularly to earn money.
exampleSentence: After graduating, my sister got a job at an engineering firm.

definition: The activity of buying and selling, or a company that does it.
exampleSentence: Her small online business sells handmade jewelry to customers worldwide.

definition: The left or right part of something, or one of its surfaces.
exampleSentence: In the United Kingdom, people drive on the left side of the road.

definition: A type or group of similar things.
exampleSentence: What kind of music do you usually listen to while studying?

definition: The top part of the body that holds the brain, eyes and mouth.
exampleSentence: Wear a helmet to protect your head when you ride a bike.

definition: Work done for customers, for example in a shop or restaurant.
exampleSentence: The food was delicious, but the service at the restaurant was slow.

definition: An area of land with its own government and borders.
exampleSentence: Canada is the second largest country in the world by area.

definition: The place where you live.
exampleSentence: After a long trip, it always feels good to come back home.

definition: A period of sixty seconds.
exampleSentence: The bus is late, but it should arrive in about a minute.

definition: A room or building where people work at desks.
exampleSentence: Our office is on the fifth floor of a tall glass building.

definition: A moving panel used to enter or leave a room or building.
exampleSentence: Please close the door quietly because the baby is sleeping.

definition: The condition of your body and mind.
exampleSentence: Eating vegetables and sleeping well are good for your health.

definition: Paintings, drawings and other creative works.
exampleSentence: The museum has a large collection of modern art from Europe.

definition: Fighting between countries or large groups of people.
exampleSentence: My grandfather told us many stories about life after the war.

definition: The study of past events.
exampleSentence: Our history lessons about ancient Rome were always really interesting.

definition: A social event where people meet to eat, drink and have fun.
exampleSentence: We are planning a surprise birthday party for our coach on Friday.

definition: Something that happens because of something else.
exampleSentence: The result of the election will be announced late tonight.

definition: The early part of the day, from sunrise until noon.
exampleSentence: I like to drink a cup of tea on the balcony every morning.

definition: The cause or explanation for something.
exampleSentence: The main reason for the delay was heavy snow at the airport.

definition: Careful study to discover new facts.
exampleSentence: Scientists are doing research on new treatments for heart disease.

definition: A female child or young woman.
exampleSentence: The girl in the red coat won first prize in the drawing contest.

definition: A male child or young man.
exampleSentence: A young boy was flying a colorful kite on the windy beach.

definition: A very short period of time.
exampleSentence: Please wait a moment while I check your reservation in the system.

definition: The mix of gases around the Earth that we breathe.
exampleSentence: The air in the mountains feels much cleaner than in the city.

definition: A person whose job is to help others learn.
exampleSentence: Our music teacher plays the piano and the guitar very well.

definition: Physical strength or power, or a group such as the police or army.
exampleSentence: The force of the wind was strong enough to knock down trees.

definition: The process of teaching and learning, especially at school.
exampleSentence: A good education can open many doors for young people.

definition: Things that people and animals eat.
exampleSentence: This market sells fresh food from local farms every weekend.

definition: Sounds arranged in a pleasant way, often with singing or instruments.
exampleSentence: I always listen to calm music when I need to concentrate.

definition: A device used to talk to people who are far away.
exampleSentence: My phone battery died, so I could not call anyone for hours.

definition: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs.
exampleSentence: Please put the plates and glasses on the kitchen table before dinner.

definition: A group of people who work or play together.
exampleSentence: Our basketball team practices three evenings a week in the gym.

definition: The amount of money you must pay for something.
exampleSentence: The price of fresh fruit usually goes up in the winter months.

definition: Energy such as electricity, or the ability to control things.
exampleSentence: The storm cut the power to our whole neighborhood last night.

definition: A written message sent by post, or a symbol such as A or B.
exampleSentence: She wrote a long letter to her pen pal in Japan.

definition: A public road in a town or city, often with houses.
exampleSentence: There is a new bakery at the end of our street.

definition: An activity with rules that people play for fun.
exampleSentence: Chess is a game that teaches patience and careful planning.
